facts.text: I am looking for ideas for a family game night.
I had a big family gathering at my grandparents' house about a month ago.
The family gathering was for my grandma's 75th birthday.
I want to plan something similar at my new apartment.
I like the idea of a theme night.
I think a retro-themed game night would be a great way to bring back memories from my grandma's 75th birthday party.
I will set up a few stations with different games so people can rotate and play what they like.
I am thinking of having a dessert bar.
I am thinking of serving brownies at the dessert bar.
I am thinking of serving apple crisp at the dessert bar.
I am thinking of serving chocolate chip cookies at the dessert bar.
I want fun decorations to create a retro vibe.
I like the idea of a neon-lit photo booth.
I want to use props like oversized sunglasses, wigs, and hats for the photo booth.
I will set up a playlist with popular retro tunes to play in the background during the party.
I want suggestions for must-have retro songs for the playlist.
I will set up stations with popular retro arcade games.
The retro arcade games I plan to include are Pac-Man, Donkey Kong, and Galaga.
I want suggestions for other retro games that would be a good fit for the party.
